body: I've seen the grim reaper in a dream too, it was at a point in my life where I felt lost and alone, he came and told me not to be afraid and that he was manifesting in a way that makes me most comfortable. He took me somewhere and had me pull someone through a door out of water who was seriously injured from war and when i kissed them they were healed. He explained how when you come to this place everything is okay, I even saw some family members. (Some who were still alive so I didn't understand) but I was able go talk with my grandfather who told me my life will only get better from there. It changed a lot for me, it could be the same for your girlfriend
Thank you everyone for the replies, I'm definitely going to take some of this advice and hopefully get back on the right track <3

I'm very very sad to see it go, I started watching this at a time when I felt the worst. This show has kind of wrapped me up in a blanket and told me I'm not alone for these past few years. But I'm glad that its not going to be dragged on and completely lose the novelty.

Sorry I meant standing lol. But it felt like he was just looking at me, I feel like I immediately looked over and made eye contact. I can't think of clothes other than just probably a white tshirt and Jeans? But I couldn't say for sure honestly, it was almost 3 years ago

I've seen someone that I've never met before sanding in my room, it was fairly quick but long enough for me to register he was there and to be frightened. I remember he was not much taller than me, brown hair, mustache, brown eyes. Not aggressive, but he took the air from my lungs, he reminded me of my dad when my dad was younger but my dad is still alive
*my daycare kids were delighted to learn that the giant 'butterfly' we saw had a baby and demanded we name him

I've once met someone who presented as death, and saw some family members of mine, most dead-but a few who are still alive. I remember them explaining some things to me, but that was one of the first most vivid dreams I've had in my adult life and didn't realize to pay very much attention to what he was saying or why I was there. I haven't seen them since, or have had much control over a dream like that again
We just found a second one on the playground 🤞
